title: Negative: in pcell-yeff-cap the L link ring can be pushed past 1.5 only by changing the tilt, and every setting that does so trades turnover for either giants or frozen small cells
summary: Short screens (128^2, my own per-cell rim/core of L, which matched labkit's 1.30-1.32 on the parent) of c06's capped-efficiency pcell: chi 3 or 4, or longer-lived links (dL 0.005 with b scaled to keep the same steady L), all fill the domain with one phase within 5000-8000 t; chi 3 with a 3 gives 16-17 cells at ring 1.5-1.6 early but grows giants as yield evolves. chi 3, a 2.5, th 0.18 keeps bounded cells at fixed yield 1.0 (31 cells, area ~45 px, ring 1.58) and 1.2 (16-23 cells, area 150-190, ring 1.53-1.69), and the evolving run keeps 13-17 cells to t=100000 with mean yield 1.0 -> 1.16, but labkit on seed 0 gives L rim/core only 1.45 (70/132 individuals membrane-like) and 0 persistent splits: the sheet shows small static cells beside a few high-yield cells that grow into irregular giants. At fixed yield 1.1 and 20000 t, the parent and the three ring settings give 0-2 persistent splits. The tilt that the links exert is what sets both the ring and cell size, so a ring of L cannot be raised independently.

finding.operator: wall-adsorption drift chi and link tilt a/th of the L link in particle-catalyst Allen-Cahn cells
finding.control: the parent pcell-yeff-cap (chi 2, a 4, th 0.15) in the same screen and at fixed yield 1.1
finding.result: chi3/chi4/dL0.005: one domain-filling phase by t=5000-8000; chi3 a3: ring 1.51-1.61 then giants; chi3 a2.5 th0.18 evolving 100000 t: 13-17 cells, mean yield 1.16 (2 seeds), labkit seed 0: L rim/core 1.45, rim/out 29.6, 0 persistent splits, 0 merges; fixed y 1.1, 20000 t: 0-2 persistent splits in all four settings
